reference: Polymetallic massive sulfide, Potter Mine (Commons title)

description.lithology: Fine-grained brown to reddish-brown metasedimentary rock, likely siltstone to mudstone, massive to deformed with contorted wispy to schlieren foliated fabric, largely obscured by sulfide overprint
description.alteration: moderate to strong oxidised / iron-oxide staining with brown to reddish-brown discolouration, overprinted by strong sulfidation
description.mineralization: brassy-yellow sulfides, likely chalcopyrite with pyrite/pyrrhotite, as semi-massive to massive blebs, patches, stringers and wispy schlieren, estimated 35-50 vol% overall and up to ~80 vol% in left piece

anomalies.explanation: Brassy-yellow metallic sulfides occur throughout both pieces as near-massive patches on the left and as wispy stringers and schlieren in brown matrix on the right, totalling ~35-50 vol%.
